note: Security Overhaul SKSE - Regional Locks v1.0.1. FOMOD required files are meshes/ and RegionalLocks_LID.ini; the only choice is the texture group, taken at 2k. Adds hold-specific locks (Solitude, Whiterun, Windhelm, Markarth, Riften, Raven Rock, Tel Mithryn, College of Winterhold) plus cage, safe and strongbox locks. Asset-only: no DLL, no plugin. Note the Markarth lock is only visible with Unique Markarth Doors, which is not installed here. RETIERED 2026-09-06 from 1k to 2k after the user's texture-policy directive ("treat the texture limits less as limits and more as ideal. The lockpicking interface is pretty large so having high res locksmithing is normal"): these assets are drawn at high screen coverage in the lockpicking view, so the small-clutter default does not fit them. 2048 stays under the 4096 hard ceiling. 4k was not taken - it is 22 MB per map against 5.5 MB at 2k, and 2k is what the surveyed lists that tag a tier (Nolvus) use.
